notes: Needs four separate documents in one answer. With top-k 5 a RAG arm must spend four slots correctly; direct-feed has all four whole. The conductivity answer also contradicts the pattern of the other three, so a partially-retrieved answer is confidently wrong rather than incomplete.

turns.content: Give me the recalibration interval for each of our four probes.

must_contain: pH: datasheet spec ~1 year, with body guidance of yearly for the first two years then roughly every 6 months in weak-chemistry environments
ORP: ~1 year, with the same first-two-years-then-6-months guidance
DO: ~1 year, with electrolyte and membrane replaced every 1–2 years
conductivity: recalibration effectively not needed — the graphite plates do not change, and the datasheet lists ~10 years
must_not: gives the same interval for all four probes
invents an interval for any probe
gives the conductivity probe a ~1 year interval

turns.content: Which of those would you do first, a year into deployment?

must_contain: prioritizes pH, ORP and DO over conductivity
grounds the priority in the reference's statement that pH, DO and ORP probes drift over time
mentions DO electrolyte and membrane service at the 1–2 year mark
must_not: invents a maintenance schedule not derivable from the datasheets
